Container.Name: yt-dlp-ui
Container.Overview: A self-hosted web UI for managing yt-dlp downloads with intelligent playlist handling. Automatically enumerate and organize playlists from YouTube channels with per-playlist download control.

Config.Name: Container Port
Config.Description: Internal container port (should match WebUI Port)

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Directory for app configuration, database, and logs

Config.Name: Downloads Directory
Config.Description: Directory where videos will be downloaded

Config.Name: Basic Auth Username
Config.Description: Username for web UI login (leave empty to disable auth)

Config.Name: Basic Auth Password
Config.Description: Password for web UI login (leave empty to disable auth)

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Secret key for session cookies and API key encryption. Set to a long random string. Sessions reset on restart if left empty.

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Appdata root: database (yt-dlp-ui.sqlite), logs, and cookies all live here. Override individual paths with DB_PATH, COOKIES_PATH if needed.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging level: error, warn, info, debug

Config.Name: Worker Concurrency
Config.Description: Concurrent yt-dlp workers. Set to 1 if getting IP-limited.

Config.Name: Downloads Path
Config.Description: Override container path for downloads (defaults to the Downloads Directory mount)
